# coverage.sh: the gate FAILS if a surface name appears here that was not
# already present at CHECK_SURFACE_ALLOWLIST_BASE_REF (default origin/main)
# — see that script's own "ratchet" section for the exact mechanics. THE
# LIST ONLY SHRINKS. Starting non-empty is expected, not a failure (mirrors
# docs/features/backfill-exempt.txt's own "shrink-only ratchet" convention,
# named in this item's acceptance criteria as the shape to follow).
# When a surface's degenerate-input fixtures land, DELETE its line here and
# ADD it (with all three absent/unreadable/empty case rows) to
# check-surface-registry.tsv in the SAME PR — never add a new line here for
# a surface that was never registered; being on this list already implies
# the surface is known to the registry mechanism and simply not yet proven.
# FORMAT — TAB-separated, two columns:
#   1. SURFACE   same grammar as check-surface-registry.tsv's SURFACE column
#                (a script path, or `<script-path>:<subcommand>`)
#   2. REASON    mandatory, non-empty, one-line justification — name the
#                tracking issue if one exists
